chinese: 于是他决定去寻找一个新家。
english: so he decided to search for a new home.

chinese: 他遇到了许多其他鸟类，但他们都认为他也很丑。
english: He met many other birds, but all of them thought that he was ugly too.

chinese: 他们不愿意和他住在一起。
english: They did not want him to live with them.

chinese: 有一天，丑小鸭遇到了一只猫和一只母鸡。
english: One day, the duckling met a cat and a hen.

chinese: “我可以和你们住在一起吗？”他满怀希望地问。
english: “May I stay with you?” he asked hopefully.
But the two animals said no.

chinese: 因为他不会咕噜叫，也不会下蛋！
english: because he could not purr or lay eggs!

chinese: 几天后，丑小鸭来到一个湖边。
english: Some days later, the ugly duckling came to a lake.

chinese: 在那里，他看到了三只美丽的天鹅，有着长长的脖子和洁白的羽毛。
english: There, he saw three beautiful swans with long necks and white feathers.

chinese: “我真希望我长得像你们一样！”他喊道。
english: “I wish I looked like you!” he cried.

chinese: “我的朋友，你确实长得像我们啊！
english: “My friend, you do look like us!

chinese: 看看水里的倒影！”其中一只天鹅说。
english: Look in the water!” one of the swans said.

chinese: 他看到自己也变成了一只美丽的白天鹅！
english: he saw that he was a beautiful white swan too!
